items.title: ScroogeFrog AI
items.source_text: ScroogeFrog AI AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget  ScroogeFrog AI helps advertisers find out where their ad budget is going to waste. It audits website traffic and Google Ads campaigns to uncover suspicious clicks, bot activity, and underperforming spend, then turns complex data into clear recommendations on what to fix. For agencies and larger advertisers, it also offers custom AI fraud detection models trained on their own traffic data. Less guesswork, more control over every advertising dollar. Marketing Advertising Artificial Intelligence

items.title: Nod by n8n
items.source_text: Nod by n8n Open source personal agent with its own computer Nod does the work around your work, in your apps and on real websites, using a private computer of its own on your Mac or PC. It takes orders only from you, asks before anything you didn't ask for, and runs on the AI provider you choose. Free, Apache 2.0. Open Source Artificial Intelligence Virtual Assistants

items.title: Plurai Simulation
items.source_text: Plurai Simulation A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run Find your agent’s worst bugs before your users do. One command in Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot builds a digital twin of your agent’s world: synthetic personas and documents, plus mocked tools, APIs and databases, in sandboxes that never touch production. API Developer Tools Artificial Intelligence

items.title: CALL-E
items.source_text: CALL-E Make phone calls with your AI agent (Muse, ChatGPT, Claude) CALL-E lets your AI assistant make phone calls for you. Ask Muse, ChatGPT or Claude to book a table, get a quote, move an appointment or check stock. CALL-E asks for anything missing, shows you the plan, and dials a real US or Canadian number after you confirm. It gets through phone menus, hold and voicemail, then brings back a summary, the transcript and what happened. Builders can add it to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenClaw with one prompt. New users get 100 free credits. Productivity Artificial Intelligence Virtual Assistants

items.title: YouArt Desktop App
items.source_text: YouArt Desktop App Codex for creative team Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly. From feature launch videos to viral remakes and clips from your long videos, it takes the whole job end to end. Bring your own API keys, and smart routing sends every shot to the cheapest provider. Marketing Artificial Intelligence Video
